Mistake during hajj 3174 views Q. Hajj 2363 views Q. Last year during HAJJ, a strange incident took place during my SAII of umrah. I had performed HAJJ-E-QIRAN. As i reached makkah at mid-night and we had to leave for MINA the next day, i decided to perform my umrah immediately without taking any rest. During my SAII, I started feeling very exhausted towards the end and i got confused with the count.After thinking over i was sure that i had completed all the 7 shawts of SAII BUT still as i did not want to take a chance i decided to continue from safa to marwa and back. As i walked towards marwah and crossed 30 percent distance i got so exhausted and sleepy that i was certain i would collapse. i was seeing safa and was worryig how i would walk upto safa and then back upto marwah. After a few seconds even before i could cross 50 percent distance towards safa i was forced to close my eyes and i thought i was going to fall. When i opened my eyes i was ascending marwah. I was amazed and did not know what happened. How coulf i have walked one and a half shawts of SAII without realizing anything. It all happened in a blink of my eye. PLEASE do the khulasa. 2397 views Q. Performing Umrah with Mehram/husband. 6379 views Q. Asak ! answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 55146 Country: India Title: ABOUT UMRAH Question: Can I do umrah before hajj? I am trying since ten years for hajj but I have no capacity for hajj now due to my economical condition. Answer ID: 55146 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1592/1324/B=10/1435) You may perform umrah in any month other than Shawwal, Zul Qadah and Zil Hijjah. It is sunnah to perform it. You may go for umrah whenever you wish. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
